hooks.name: Run pytest on src/ save
hooks.description: Run the full pytest suite whenever a file in src/ is saved. Fails fast on the first broken test and prints a short traceback.

action.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/ -x -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -30 && echo "✅ All tests passed." || echo "❌ Tests failed — see output above."
